subtext: From company formation to visas, banking, and tax — we handle everything end-to-end so you can focus on growing your business in the UAE's thriving economy.

ctaSecondary.message: Hi! I'd like to discuss my Dubai business setup.

reviews.name: ZeeShan Butt
reviews.text: Brightlink management deserved 100/100. Muhammad Bilal Saleem & his team is amazing, and they prove with work. Golden Visa and nationality change service A 2 Z completed in less than 36 hours. Entire process was smooth and stress-free. It's really VIP service (Super Sonic Team).

reviews.name: Muhammad
reviews.text: Great experience working with Brightlink Team for my Golden Visa. They were professional, responsive, and handled the entire process smoothly. Got the visa within 2 days. Highly recommended for anyone looking for fast and smooth golden visa process.

reviews.name: Ritik Gupta
reviews.text: Hi, I got my 2 year residency visa done through Brightlink Management Consultancy and they were thoroughly professional and got it done in 4 business days — that too during Ramadan with shortened working hours. Highly recommend their VIP package!

reviews.name: Sina Behfard
reviews.text: The team is working very efficiently, professionally, and transparently. They were very supportive to quickly takeover my application which had got stuck for days with another company and took care of each step with great care.

reviews.name: M J
reviews.text: Excellent service with prompt response and follow-up action. Used their service for Golden Visa which took three days to process from start to finish.

reviews.name: Hakan TEKERCIOGLU
reviews.text: Our family's Golden Visa application process was completed smoothly, on time, and at reasonable prices. I would definitely recommend this service to anyone who needs it.

reviews.name: Amin K
reviews.text: The service provided by Brightlink was nothing but excellent! From getting details and a price quote to fulfillment of my Emirates ID in hand was a seamless and expeditious process. Thank you Mr. Bilal, Mr. Abbas and the entire team!

reviews.name: Tausif Ahmad
reviews.text: Excellent service. Very honest and helpful team. Got all paperwork done in a week with no hidden charges. Especially thanks to Mr. Abbas.

reviews.name: Clay Mullens
reviews.text: Abbas and the Brightlink team were amazing!! From my initial contact they were extremely helpful and responded swiftly. They delivered exactly what I was after. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for fast golden visa service.

reviews.name: Manaqib Ashraf
reviews.text: I recently processed my family visa through Brightlink, and I couldn't be happier with the service. The entire process was handled very quickly and professionally. Now I can live with my family here in the UAE. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Ahmed Ullah
reviews.text: Just wanted to say a big thank you for the amazing support in getting my wife's visa done — and that too in just 2 days! I really appreciate how smoothly and quickly everything was handled. Your team's professionalism is truly exceptional.

reviews.name: Numan Shabbir
reviews.text: Loved the whole experience. Got our visas in just 3 days. Their whole team is very experienced and provide updates at all steps. Would recommend to anyone looking to setup business in Dubai or get Golden Visas.
